transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

I’m not really sure where to start. I… I came in because I’ve been doing things that scare me a little. Like leaving in the middle of work deployments, or driving around late at night with nowhere to go. That’s not how I usually handle stress.
Do you feel a strong urge or compulsion to leave work or drive around at night, or do these actions feel more like something you just decide to do on a whim?

It’s not exactly a compulsion. I don’t feel like I have to do it in that way. It’s more like… I suddenly decide I can’t stay there, or I get in the car with no real plan. And afterward it scares me, because that’s not how I usually handle things.
While you’re driving around at night or leaving work, do you ever feel detached from yourself, like you’re watching yourself from the outside, or like things around you don’t feel real?
I don’t know. I haven’t really noticed that exactly. It’s more like I’m just… trying to get away from where I am, I guess. I’m not sure about feeling outside myself.
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually energized, needed less sleep, or felt like your thoughts were racing? Even if just for a short time?
I don’t think so. I mean… I have trouble sleeping sometimes, but not like I’m full of energy or anything. I haven’t noticed racing thoughts in that way.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, even if just for a while?

Yeah… I guess I have. I used to have things I’d actually look forward to—salsa, book club, yoga, having people over for Guatemalan food. Lately I just cancel most of it and stay home. I’ll sit there scrolling or have some show on that I’m not really watching.
When you canceled things like salsa, book club, or yoga, did you feel like you couldn’t enjoy them anymore, even when you did go?

Yeah… I think so. Even when I do make myself go, it’s like I’m just there. I used to plan my week around salsa or book club or yoga, and now I mostly end up canceling and sitting at home scrolling, or pretending to watch something.
When you went to things like salsa, book club, or yoga recently, did you feel any pleasure or enjoyment from them, even a little?

Maybe a little, but not really. I used to plan my whole week around salsa or book club or yoga… or having people over. Now I usually cancel, and if I do go, I’m just kind of there. Then I go home and scroll or put on a show I’m not really watching.
Have you experienced any days where you felt down or hopeless nearly every day for most of the day, and this was a noticeable change from how you usually feel?
I don’t know… maybe some days, yeah. I haven’t really been tracking it like that. It’s just been… different, I guess, but I’m not sure about “most of the day” or nearly every day.
Have you had several days in a row where you felt down or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, and this felt like a real change from how you normally are?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had stretches where I felt pretty low, but I don’t know if it was most of the day or nearly every day. I haven’t been keeping track like that.
Have you had several days in a row where you felt down or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, and this felt like a real change from how you normally are?
I guess I still can’t say for sure. It’s been low on and off, but I don’t know if I’d call it most of the day for days in a row. I just… haven’t really been measuring it that way.
Can you think of a time in the last few weeks when you felt down or hopeless for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks straight?
I don’t think I can point to a full two weeks like that. I’ve had low days, but… not something I’m sure was most of the day every day.
Have you found that you no longer take any pleasure or interest in activities you used to enjoy, even when you make yourself do them?

Yeah… I guess so. I used to do things like salsa, book club, yoga, have people over for Guatemalan food. Now I mostly cancel and just stay home, scrolling or pretending to watch something. It doesn’t really… feel like much.
Has there been a time in the past few weeks when you completely stopped getting any pleasure or interest from almost all activities, even the ones you used to really enjoy?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I used to kind of build my week around salsa, book club, yoga, having people over for Guatemalan food. Lately I just cancel most of it and sit at home scrolling, or put on a show and don’t really watch it. It just doesn’t… do much for me.
Has there been a period of at least two weeks in the past few weeks when you completely stopped getting any pleasure or interest from almost all activities, even the ones you used to really enjoy?

Yeah… I think it’s been around that long. I used to plan my week around salsa or book club, yoga, having people over for Guatemalan food. Lately I mostly cancel and just sit at home scrolling, or put on a show and barely watch it. It just doesn’t really feel like anything.
Over the past few weeks, was there a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt down or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day?
I… don’t know. I’ve had some low days, but I’m not sure I’d say most of the day, nearly every day for two weeks. It kind of comes and goes.
Was there a period of at least two weeks where you completely stopped getting any pleasure or interest from almost all activities, even the ones you used to really enjoy?

Yeah… like I said, I used to actually look forward to salsa, book club, yoga, having people over. Lately I just cancel most of it and stay home scrolling, or put on a show and don’t really watch it. It’s… not much feels enjoyable.
Over the past few weeks, was there a time when you felt down or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, even if it didn’t last the whole day?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I’ve felt low at times, but I don’t know that it’s been most of the day, nearly every day. It’s hard for me to pin down.
Over the past few weeks, was there a time when you felt down or hopeless nearly every day, even if it wasn’t all day each day?

Yeah… I guess nearly every day there’s something. Not always “down” exactly, but this tight feeling, like fear and shame just sitting there. Even when nothing’s happening, I feel like I should’ve handled things better… or like I can’t really let my guard down.
